dimensions.label: Venue-selection criteria
without_history: For the proposed 150-person Manhattan Spring Gala on April 17, 2027, pursue Chelsea Atelier’s reception as the sole supplied venue option within the $18,000 cost ceiling. Its preliminary cost is $15,400, with $4,250 needed upfront. Finance finds it affordable with conditions—not authorized. A warm reception honoring Sabrina, with a short, consent-led recovery talk, fits the intended program, but the standing-only format presents a material inclusion concern. Do not commit until seating accommodations and accessibility are confirmed, unrestricted cash is verified, and the board addresses the fundraising-target shortfall.

Chelsea’s supplied reception capacity is 200 for the planned 150 guests. Outside catering is permitted, no food-and-beverage minimum is stated, and a small speaker stage supports the program. All venue details remain synthetic and unconfirmed.

Preliminary expense budget: venue $1,800; catering $8,700; entertainment $1,500; marketing $600; staffing $900; insurance and permits $500; miscellaneous $0. Supplied subtotal: $14,000; contingency: $1,400; total: $15,400. The miscellaneous allowance does not establish that no additional costs will arise.

The $4,250 upfront requirement passes the supplied model’s check against $9,938 of planning capacity above the $11,562 reserve floor. That capacity must be verified as unrestricted cash still available when payments are due. Recorded income, projected ticket receipts, restricted funds and pledged sponsorship are not available deposit money.

At the modeled $250 standard ticket, the base case assumes 150 attendees, $37,500 in ticket revenue, $5,000 in sponsorship and $4,342.50 in donations. Supplied total revenue is $46,842.50 and net proceeds are $31,442.50. Sponsorship and demand are unconfirmed.

The conservative case assumes 120 attendees, $31,737 in total revenue and $16,337 in net proceeds. Optimistic net proceeds are $35,245.25. None of the supplied net scenarios reaches $40,000; the board must clarify whether that goal means gross revenue or net proceeds.
A standing-only reception could exclude guests who cannot stand for extended periods. Accessible entry, restrooms, stage access, rest seating, dietary support and a quieter area are unknown.
Whether the $40,000 goal means gross revenue or net proceeds; if it means net, whether lower projected proceeds are acceptable or the plan must be revised or deferred.
Have a board-designated person verify venue identity and contact details, review the inquiry below, and send it outside SAM SPACE only if the board agrees.

Unsent venue inquiry draft To: Chelsea Atelier (synthetic; verified contact needed) Subject: Inquiry: Manhattan Spring Gala on April 17, 2027 Hello, The Sabrina Audrey Milone Foundation is exploring a reception-style fundraising gala for 150 guests in Manhattan on April 17, 2027. We envision a warm, personal evening honoring Sabrina, with a brief tribute and a short recovery-speaker talk. Could you confirm availability, capacity and current itemized pricing, including required fees, deposit and payment schedules, cancellation terms, insurance and permit requirements? Please also confirm outside-catering rules and whether any food-and-beverage minimum applies. We understand the proposed format is standing-only. Can you permit sufficient seating accommodations for guests who cannot stand for extended periods? We would also appreciate details on the speaker stage, AV equipment and staffing requirements. Please share these details so our board can assess suitability and affordability. This is an exploratory inquiry, not a booking or commitment. Thank you.

method_note: A with-history statement counts as changed by history only if the agents themselves attributed it to past events (the recommendation's or shortlist's 'lessons applied', or a statement naming a recorded event) AND it rests on a specific lesson: one citing the event it names, or sharing at least three meaningful words. That lesson is shown. Other wording differences between the two runs are counted separately as possible model variation, never as improvements.
